topics.title: Two RWE Studies for VicaEMPA (CRM) – PEC Content Endorsement

background.text: Two RWE study proposals for VicaEMPA (CRM TA) were presented by Chloe Wang and Wenjing Tan at PEC on 15 Dec 2025 for content endorsement.
background.quote: (E) Two RWE studies for VicaEMPA Chloe Wang, Wenjing Tan

for_endorsement.text: Two RWE study proposals for VicaEMPA submitted to PEC for content endorsement.

decision.text: PEC endorsed both RWE study proposals without any comments, highly recognizing their value especially the business value.
decision.quote:
Endorsed
PEC comments:
• PEC highly recognized the value of the two RWE studies, especially the business value and endorsed the study
proposals without any comments.
